about: Calibrated quantitation (elemental, TOC, AAS, ICP-OES / MS, XRF, Hg, RGA, Orbitrap, IRMS, SFA): source, method, load, calibrate, use-curve, blank, measure, stop, result, export, records, status. Ranges, enums and units come from each contract; samples are put in by the operator (task worlds in tasks/quant_analyzer_world.py).

excluded.eco_ncld822: continuous chemiluminescence NOx analyzer with zero / span gas checks, no blank-standards-curve-sample workflow: primary in gas_fluid; not added here
excluded.wtw_oxitopi: BOD by head pressure on six manual measuring heads (thin class); no calibration or record object
excluded.hach_dr6000: photometric concentration programs: primary in spectroscopy, whose blank / measure verbs cover it

measure.message: the furnaces of {inst} are not at their set temperatures (or no method is set).
measure.fix: set the furnaces (`chemlab call {inst} furnace.configure ...`) and the method, wait until ready (`chemlab run {inst} status`).
measure.label: furnaces ready

unsupported.source: no source switch: the combustion and reduction furnaces are set with furnace.configure and heat whenever the power is on
unsupported.load: capsules are weighed into the autosampler by the lab operator (no agent capability for it); the agent chooses the slots with `measure --slots`
unsupported.use-curve: one curve per element (C, H, N, S), used as soon as it is fitted - nothing to select
unsupported.records: no record store: the last sequence is the result (`chemlab run INST result`)

alternatives.source: set the furnaces with `chemlab call INST furnace.configure --combustion_k 1373.15 --reduction_k 1123.15`.
alternatives.load: ask the operator which slots hold the capsules; run them with `chemlab run INST measure --slots 0,1,2 --wait`.
alternatives.records: `chemlab run INST result` shows every slot of the last sequence.

params.manual: INRAE vario EL cube operating guide (HAL hal-02959166) pp. 11-29 (sample table, standards, Auto/Single start, daily factor); flyer pp. 2-3

calibrate: --from lists autosampler slots of the last sequence (the standards), --reference their reference id; the slot masses come from the sequence
CURVE is the element (C, H, N or S); fit each element you need
measure: --slots runs sequence.configure + sequence.start; the operator has weighed the capsules into those slots

measure: --slot N measures one slot (measurement.start); --slots a,b,c runs them as a sequence (sequence.start)

measure.message: {inst} is not ready: carrier gas, a fresh crucible, the furnace closed and the loader back are all needed.
measure.fix: switch the gas on (`chemlab run {inst} source on`); close the furnace (`chemlab run {inst} close furnace`); the loader must be back (`chemlab call {inst} loading.set --loading false`).
measure.label: ready

unsupported.load: the lab operator drops the weighed sample into the loading head (no agent capability for it); the agent moves the loader with loading.set

alternatives.load: bring the loader to the load position (`chemlab call INST loading.set --loading true`), let the operator drop the sample, then `chemlab call INST loading.set --loading false`.

source.message: the analyser of {inst} is not under vacuum ({value}).
source.fix: pump it down: `chemlab call {inst} vacuum.pump_down`, wait until `chemlab read {inst} vacuum.state` is ready (about 5 min).
source.label: vacuum ready

measure.message: {inst} is not ready to acquire (status {value}: vacuum, filament or magnet).
measure.fix: switch the filament on (`chemlab run {inst} source on --wait`), set the gas (`method species=CO2 carrier=on`).
measure.label: status green

unsupported.use-curve: the delta-scale normalisation applies to the results as soon as it is fitted - nothing to select
unsupported.blank: no blank value: the reference-gas pulses of each acquisition are the working reference
unsupported.export: no export capability: results come from the peak table (`chemlab run INST result --save-to F`)
unsupported.records: no record store: the peak table of the session is the result (`chemlab run INST result`)

alternatives.records: `chemlab run INST result` lists every peak with its number (for calibrate --from PEAK=SUBSTANCE).

params.manual: isoprime precisION brochure 05 005 646 pp. 2-6 (ionOS, centrION continuous-flow interface), 13-14 (technical data)

method: no method object: species= sets the magnet (magnet.set_species), inlet= carrier= flow= dilution= sleep= set the Centrion (centrion.set), amplifier= the amplifier mode; the working-reference deltas are assigned with `chemlab call INST reference.assign`
measure: a timed acquisition (--time, default 5 min) with one reference-gas pulse of gas 1 at 20 s; inject samples with `load` while it runs
load: NAME is a reference material id (substance_id) when the instrument knows it, else a sample id the lab declared

measure.message: the pump of {inst} is not running (the system is not started up).
measure.fix: start it up: `chemlab call {inst} system.startup`, wait until system.state is ready (about 35 min).
measure.label: pump running

unsupported.use-curve: each run is calibrated from its own calibrant cups - nothing to select
unsupported.blank: no blank query: baseline and blank cups are part of the run (`measure --cups ...:baseline`)
unsupported.export: no export capability: `chemlab run INST result --save-to F` keeps the result
unsupported.records: no record store: the last run is the result (`chemlab run INST result`)

params.manual: AA500 brochure (2024) pp. 2-3 (segmented flow, automated start-up, standards, lamps, baths); product page (run workflow: baseline, sample list, calibrants)

calibrate: recalculates the calibration of the last run from its calibrant cups (data.recalculate): --fit linear|quadratic|auto, --no-drift, --no-carryover
measure: --cups RACK:POS:TYPE,... in run order (types baseline, calibrant, sample, drift, ...); --time = sample time per cup, --wash = wash time
source: --channel 1..4: the detector LED of one channel
method: method method=MT508_A026_nitrate_nitrite --channel 1 (the channel needs the pump tubes of that method)
